lede: Jacksonville Jaguars carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#4 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#6 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Jacksonville Jaguars -4.0 with a fair total of 43.2 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Philadelphia Eagles pass offence vs Jacksonville Jaguars pass defence, which sits −0.154 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
